* chore(deps): bump kohana-aliases to v1.0.0

Makes Model_Uri __sleep and __wakeup public: PHP 8 warns about private
magic methods and prints the warning into the first page after FPM start.

* chore(docker): upgrade PHP from 7.2 to 8.4.27

PHP 8.4.27 fixes CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (RCE in PHP-FPM),
PHP 7.2 does not get security fixes.

- use Debian Bookworm image: it ships ImageMagick 6 where
  Imagick::setImageOpacity() used by social covers still exists
- install memcache 8.2, imagick 3.8.1 and redis 6.3.0 from PECL
- use new GD configure flags
- build fontconfig cache to avoid errors in FPM logs

* chore(deps): update hawk.php and drop phpunit 3.7 for PHP 8

- codex-team/hawk.php 2.1.4 requires PHP ^7.1, update to 2.3.0
- phpunit 3.7 can not be installed or run on PHP 8, the only test is a sample

* fix: make Kohana core compatible with PHP 8

- Arr::path() passed Config_Group to array_key_exists(), which throws
  TypeError since PHP 8.0 and broke every POST request via XSS filter
- replace each() removed in PHP 8.0 in Response::cookie()
- drop imagerotate() ignore_transparent argument removed in PHP 8.3

* fix: disable E_DEPRECATED on production

Kohana converts every reported error into an exception, and Kohana 3.3
raises a lot of deprecations on PHP 8, so production returned 500 on
every page. E_STRICT constant is deprecated in PHP 8.4.

* Build frontend

* chore(deps): update AWS SDK and Guzzle to fix security advisories

composer update aws/aws-sdk-php guzzlehttp/guzzle guzzlehttp/psr7 \
    guzzlehttp/promises mtdowling/jmespath.php -W

Closes 18 advisories reported by `composer audit`:

- mtdowling/jmespath.php 2.6.1 -> 2.9.2: CVE-2026-54133
- aws/aws-sdk-php 3.256.2 -> 3.401.4: CVE-2023-51651, CVE-2025-14761,
  GHSA-27qh-8cxx-2cr5 (CloudFront policy injection, no CVE)
- guzzlehttp/guzzle 7.5.0 -> 7.16.0: CVE-2026-55568, CVE-2026-55767,
  CVE-2026-59883, CVE-2026-67339, CVE-2026-67353, CVE-2026-67354,
  CVE-2026-67355, CVE-2026-69245, CVE-2026-69246
- guzzlehttp/psr7 2.4.3 -> 2.13.2: CVE-2023-29197, CVE-2026-48998,
  CVE-2026-49214, CVE-2026-55766, CVE-2026-59882

Dependencies updated along: guzzlehttp/promises 1.5.2 -> 2.6.0,
aws/aws-crt-php v1.0.2 -> v1.2.7, psr/http-message 1.0.1 -> 2.0,
psr/http-client 1.0.1 -> 1.0.3, psr/http-factory 1.0.1 -> 1.1.0,
symfony/deprecation-contracts v2.5.2 -> v3.7.1,
symfony/polyfill-ctype v1.23.0 -> v1.37.0,
symfony/polyfill-mbstring v1.27.0 -> v1.43.0,
new symfony/filesystem v8.1.9 and symfony/polyfill-php80 v1.43.0.

aws/aws-sdk-php now requires PHP >= 8.1 and symfony/filesystem 8.1
requires PHP >= 8.4.1, so this lock needs the php-8.4-upgrade image.

* Build frontend

* fix(image): keep GD transformations on PHP 8

Since PHP 8.0 GD returns GdImage objects instead of resources, so
_load_image() treated a loaded image as not loaded and reloaded the
original file on save() and render(), losing rotate, resize and crop.
